result.short: CAUSE FOUND. Verdict (b): shown and total bytes measure different strings in core. Not a plugin bug. Shown = bytes of the NUMBERED text (cat -n "N<tab>line") cut to 1000 lines = 5892 B (truncation-parts.ts:354, kept). Total = RAW file bytes = 2200 (tools.ts:977 renderTextRead sets _truncCtx.totalBytes = byteLength(content); truncation-parts.ts:299 uses ctx.totalBytes first). Scenario: scenarios-extra.ts:576-586 (1100 lines of "l" + final \n = 2200 B, 1101 split lines). The plugin synthetic-text.ts:137-143 prints both numbers as given. Probe (bun -e in core, truncateToolOutputParts with numbered text and ctx totalBytes 2200, totalLines 1101) printed `2200 1101 5892 2200 1000 1101` = fileBytes fileLines shownBytes totalBytes shownLines totalLines. Other goldens: read-truncated and output-preview-read-blob say "12782 of 28890 bytes, 1000/3001 lines"; the raw file is 28890 B (checked), 12782 = numbered 1000 lines; shown < total so it looks fine, but it is the same mix of units. blob-spill and plugin-tool-clamp also have "truncated: shown" (not Read; Unverified). The old core had the same numbers: the golden was added in commits 8319d93/8656bba when core still built the text inline (Unverified: I did not run old code). A fix would touch core tools.ts:977 or truncation-parts.ts:299 (or only the notice wording in the plugin), and the numbers in these notices in 3 goldens plus the TUI footer X/Y B and info.totalBytes. No golden change proposed; the lead must approve. Recommendation: fix later (not M3c). The numbers are stable and pinned, and a fix changes core, the TUI footer and several goldens; M3c rules say 0 byte change. Record it as a known issue.
